description: The numbers of the 2004 Oddlabs release. Every unit, building, weapon and spell number was checked against the Oddlabs source (oddlabs/master) and none was changed by Resurrected, so this file overrides nothing; RulesetTest pins it to the 2004 values in case the base ever moves. Engine changes since 2004 that this ruleset does not revert are listed in docs/rulesets.md.
